title: PAH-OMC-012 full-Q charge-graded domain and neutral refinement map
question: Does a source-owned disjoint-union over all finite PAH-001 charge sectors make the unchanged neutral coordinate restriction total and unique for every n>=2 and R_max>=1, with nonzero R-488 cylinder lifts and exact fixed-Q component recovery?
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-004, PAH-OMC-008, PAH-OMC-010, the OMC-010 manifest, PAH-OMC-011 and the R-490 primary run before computation.
Define Omega_n^gr(R) as the disjoint union of the already declared fixed-Q finite PAH-001 components, with Q_n={0,...,M_psi|V_n|}; do not add a cross-Q probability mixture.
Define the unchanged neutral projection by retaining every old coordinate, dropping only the new column and d_n link, and recomputing the coarse grade from retained ell coordinates.

Derive Q_f-Q_c as the nonnegative sum of dropped ell coordinates, prove the coarse bound and deterministic uniqueness, and replay binary and singleton patterns for n=2..7 and representative R_max values.
Use explicit ell_a, ell_d, H_0 and H_1 witnesses with positive finite Gibbs weights, verify componentwise PAH-001 generator/Gibbs recovery, run independent and hostile lanes, and compile Lean R492.
finding: The full-Q graded union makes the neutral coordinate restriction a total deterministic map into exactly one coarse graded component. Retained charges are unchanged and the omitted charge is recorded by the grade balance Q_f-Q_c=sum_dropped ell>=0. The four R-488 cylinder generators have nonzero lifted witnesses with positive finite component Gibbs weight. Each fixed-Q block remains exactly the PAH-001 functional, move set, generator and pi_(rho,Q).
decision_reason: R-492 closes only the finite full-Q bookkeeping/domain gate that blocked R-491. It does not alter PAH-001, does not preserve a fixed Q across levels, and does not prove any generator intertwining. A separate PAH-OMC-011 re-test is now eligible because the lift is a total function on the graded domain.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite domain/map result for the unchanged PAH-OMC-004 strip and PAH-OMC-010 parameter path. The direct-sum Gibbs reference is componentwise; no cross-Q mixing probability is asserted.
evidence_level: T0 exact finite charge-balance and map-totality argument with primary 17/17, independent 15/15, hostile 10/10, integrated 16/16 and Lean R492 PASS

assumptions: All parent files remain byte-identical at the listed hashes.
The PAH-001 radial levels are nonnegative and bounded by M_psi, so the retained charge sum is in the coarse admissible range.
The neutral refinement is geometric coordinate restriction exactly as declared by PAH-OMC-004; no hidden charge operation is inserted.
PAH-001 moves preserve Q, so its generator is block diagonal on the graded union.
A finite component Gibbs state is used for each Q exactly as PAH-001 declares; no cross-Q mixture is needed for this domain-map gate.
missing_assumptions: A source-authorized cross-Q mixing law would still be needed if a later theorem requires one normalized probability over the whole disjoint union.
The rootwise generator-intertwining identity and any weak Gibbs-L2 convergence must be tested separately on the now-total graded domain.
non_claims: No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
No PAH-OMC-011 generator intertwining theorem is claimed by R-492.
No charge is redistributed, no conditional Gibbs average is taken, and no PAH-001 functional, rate, carrier or counterterm is changed.
The componentwise Gibbs family is not a newly asserted global probability measure over Q.
Markov time remains external stochastic time.
next_action: Run one dedicated PAH-OMC-011 re-test using this total graded domain, with unchanged root correspondence and C_sw=540 as domination-only input; stop at the first exact rootwise mismatch.
revisit_condition: Reopen this domain result only if a parent hash changes, a totality/uniqueness counterexample is found, a source-authorized global Gibbs mixing law is supplied, or the PAH-OMC-011 re-test identifies a domain-independent rootwise obstruction.
stop_or_redesign: Do not convert the grade-changing map into a fixed-Q map by deleting or redistributing charge.
Do not add a cross-Q fitted weight or conditional averaging to manufacture a global Gibbs probability.
Do not treat this domain advance as an intertwining, infinite-volume, continuum or physical-sector result.
reproduction: Set-Location verification/lean; lake env lean Tect/R492.lean

adversarial_review.check: Could the graded union silently add a new dynamics?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: the generator is defined componentwise and every move/rate string is inherited from PAH-001; no cross-Q transition is added.

adversarial_review.check: Could omitted new-column charge be hidden by resetting the grade to fixed Q?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: Q_f-Q_c is recorded exactly as the nonnegative dropped-coordinate sum and the grade is explicitly allowed to change.

adversarial_review.check: Could a direct-sum Gibbs family be misreported as one normalized global state?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD AS LIMITATION: the contract and non-claim leave cross-Q mixing undefined and prohibit fitted weights.

adversarial_review.check: Could nonzero R-488 lifts be vacuous?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: ell_a, ell_d, H_0 and H_1 each have explicit nonzero witnesses at positive finite component Gibbs weight.
